Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Attached is a first-pass Takeoff Manifest (Greenfield_MAP_v1.xlsx) and the draft SOW (SOW_Greenfield_v1.pdf). The manifest is organized as a lightweight Mutual Action Plan with the milestones we discussed, owners, and proposed target dates.

High-level milestones (proposed):
- Week 0 (2026-08-23): Kickoff + environment access (Greenfield IT) — Owner: Greenfield IT
- Week 2 (2026-09-06): Secure production VPC peering & key rotation — Owner: Redwood Security (Olga)
- Week 4 (2026-09-20): Data onboarding (sanitized sample set) + acceptance tests — Owner: Greenfield Analytics
- Week 6 (2026-10-04): Final model tuning & performance baseline — Owner: Marcus (Redwood)
- Week 8 (2026-10-18): Go-live cutover window + 72h hypercare — Joint owners

Acceptance criteria are in the manifest (tab “Acceptance”): token-level latency < 350ms p95 on 2k qps synthetic, embedding similarity baseline >= 0.82, and SOC-adjacent audit artifacts for the provisioning window.

Can you confirm that these owners/dates look feasible from your side? I flagged the items that typically trigger procurement (SOW signature, ARO for peering) so Procurement is copied on future messages.

Attachments: Greenfield_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP), SOW_Greenfield_v1.pdf (SOW), network-diagram.png (network stub)

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm owners & any blackout windows by EOD Thu 2026-08-19
2) If procurement needs changes to the SOW, we'll provision a DocuSign link and target an internal PO by 2026-08-27
3) Kickoff scheduled for Mon 2026-08-23 at 9:00am PT (tentative)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0194
